mapper.select: SELECT supplier_id AS "id",supplier_name AS "supplierName" FROM supplier ORDER BY supplier_id
SELECT product_id AS "id",product_name AS "title",unit_price AS "price" FROM product ORDER BY product_id
SELECT customer_id AS "id",customer_name AS "label",address AS "city" FROM customer ORDER BY customer_id

SELECT i.item_id AS "itemId",g.product_name AS "productName",v.supplier_name AS "supplierName",i.serial_no AS "serialNo",CASE WHEN i.purchase_id IS NULL THEN '未售出' ELSE '已售出' END AS "state" FROM console_product_item i JOIN product g ON g.product_id=i.product_id JOIN supplier v ON v.supplier_id=i.supplier_id ORDER BY i.item_id

SELECT v.supplier_id AS "supplierId",v.supplier_name AS "supplierName",g.product_id AS "productId",g.product_name AS "productName" FROM supplier_product r JOIN supplier v ON v.supplier_id=r.supplier_id JOIN product g ON g.product_id=r.product_id ORDER BY v.supplier_id,g.product_id

SELECT p.purchase_id AS "saleId",i.item_id AS "itemId",i.serial_no AS "serialNo",g.product_id AS "productId",g.product_name AS "productName",v.supplier_id AS "supplierId",v.supplier_name AS "supplierName",b.customer_id AS "customerId",b.customer_name AS "customerName",p.unit_price AS "salePrice",p.purchased_at AS "soldOn",p.quantity AS "quantity" FROM purchase p JOIN product g ON g.product_id=p.product_id JOIN supplier v ON v.supplier_id=p.supplier_id JOIN customer b ON b.customer_id=p.customer_id LEFT JOIN console_product_item i ON i.purchase_id=p.purchase_id AND g.product_id=#{productId}AND v.supplier_id=#{supplierId}AND b.customer_id=#{customerId} ORDER BY p.purchase_id,i.item_id
SELECT DISTINCT g.product_id AS "productId",g.product_name AS "productName" FROM product g JOIN purchase p ON p.product_id=g.product_id WHERE p.supplier_id=#{id} ORDER BY g.product_id
SELECT DISTINCT b.customer_id AS "customerId",b.customer_name AS "customerName" FROM customer b JOIN purchase p ON p.customer_id=b.customer_id WHERE p.supplier_id=#{id} ORDER BY b.customer_id

SELECT DISTINCT b.customer_id AS "customerId",b.customer_name AS "customerName" FROM customer b JOIN purchase p ON p.customer_id=b.customer_id JOIN product_service s ON s.purchase_id=p.purchase_id WHERE p.supplier_id=#{id} ORDER BY b.customer_id

SELECT s.service_id AS "id",CONCAT(s.service_type,'：',COALESCE(s.service_note,'')) AS "description",b.customer_name AS "customerName",s.serviced_at AS "serviceDate" FROM product_service s JOIN purchase p ON p.purchase_id=s.purchase_id JOIN customer b ON b.customer_id=p.customer_id WHERE p.supplier_id=#{id} ORDER BY s.service_id
SELECT supplier_id AS id,supplier_name AS label FROM supplier WHERE supplier_id=#{id}
